sys_remote_update_set.description: Workspace Request Exception dialog: the Defer until date is now limited per reason - Risk Accepted allows at most 180 days from today, Fix Unavailable at most 90; a date past the limit shows "Select a date within N days from today." and Submit stays disabled. Enforced in three places on the Request Exception Unified modal (Security Exception Management app): the updateUntilDate client script (caps the allowed interval when the date changes), the validateFormFields client script (re-checks when the reason changes after a date was picked), and the "Request Exception action" data broker (server-side refusal, so the rule holds for any client). The configured interval (sn_sec_exception.config_max_duration / per-table request_exception_beyond) still applies when it is shorter.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Request Exception Unified">b38e662833216a10fd9f96382e5c7b0c</macroponent><name>updateUntilDate</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Please choose a valid future date in the format (yyyy-MM-dd)"
    },
    {
        "message": "Select a date within {0} days from today."
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports,
    params
}) {
    var dateRegex = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
    var validPayloadDate;
    if (event.elementId === "date_input_text") {
        validPayloadDate = (event.payload.fieldValue.match(dateRegex)) ? "" + event.payload.fieldValue : "";
    } else {
        validPayloadDate = event.payload.value;
    }

    function convertDateStr(date) {
        var convertedDateYear = new Date(date).getFullYear();
        var convertedDateMonth = pad(new Date(date).getMonth() + 1);
        var convertedDateDay = pad(new Date(date).getDate());
        var convertedDate = convertedDateYear + '-' + convertedDateMonth + '-' + convertedDateDay;
        return convertedDate;
    }
    var currentDate = convertDateStr(new Date());

    api.data.valid_until_date_1.refresh();
    var options = api.data.valid_until_date_1.output;
    var intervalValue = options[0].intervalValue;
    // Reason-specific deferral limits: Risk Accepted (2) allows at
    // most 180 days, Fix Unavailable (23) at most 90. The shorter of
    // the configured interval and the reason limit wins.
    var reasonCaps = { '2': 180, '23': 90 };
    var reasonCap = reasonCaps['' + api.state.reason];
    if (reasonCap && reasonCap < parseInt(intervalValue))
        intervalValue = reasonCap;
    var expectedUntilDate;
    var expectedUntilDate = new Date(new Date().setDate(new Date().getDate() + parseInt(intervalValue)));
    expectedUntilDate = convertDateStr(expectedUntilDate);

    function pad(n) {
        return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n;
    };
    const localizedMessage = await helpers.translate("Please choose a valid future date in the format (yyyy-MM-dd)");
    var alertMessage = [{
        "status": "critical",
        "content": localizedMessage,
        "icon": "circle-exclamation-outline"
    }];
    api.setState("alertMessage", localizedMessage);
    if (new Date(currentDate).valueOf() < new Date(validPayloadDate).valueOf()) {
        if (new Date(validPayloadDate).valueOf() <= new Date(expectedUntilDate).valueOf()) {
            api.setState("untilDate", validPayloadDate);
            api.setState("errorMessage", []);
            api.setState("isValidUntilDate", true);
        } else {
            api.setState("untilDate", validPayloadDate);
            var validUntilMessageTemp = api.state.validUntilMessage;
            helpers.translate("Select a date within {0} days from today.", intervalValue).then((value) => {
                validUntilMessageTemp[0].content = value;
                api.setState("validUntilMessage", validUntilMessageTemp);
                api.setState("alertMessage", validUntilMessageTemp[0].content);
            });
            api.setState("errorMessage", api.state.validUntilMessage);
            api.setState("isValidUntilDate", false);
        }
    } else if (new Date(currentDate).valueOf() === new Date(validPayloadDate).valueOf()) {
        if (new Date(api.state.untilDate).valueOf() < new Date(currentDate).valueOf()) {
            api.setState("errorMessage", alertMessage);
            api.setState("isValidUntilDate", false);
            
        }
    } else {
        api.setState("untilDate", validPayloadDate);
        api.setState("errorMessage", alertMessage);
        api.setState("isValidUntilDate", false);
    }
    api.emit('VALIDATE_FROM_FIELDS_2', {});
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-05-16 07:20:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>9c4145a5ff656210d317ffffffffff15</sys_id><sys_mod_count>46</sys_mod_count><sys_name>updateUntilDate</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Exception Management for Unified Security Exposure Management" source="sn_sec_exception">80a1334f8b9a48cba8b4f4c240c1a4de</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Exception Management for Unified Security Exposure Management">80a1334f8b9a48cba8b4f4c240c1a4de</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9c4145a5ff656210d317ffffffffff15</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-21 05:50:39</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Request Exception Unified">b38e662833216a10fd9f96382e5c7b0c</macroponent><name>validateFormFields</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Select a date within {0} days from today."
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    var dateValid = true;
    var infoValid = true;
    var reasonValid = true;
    var disableSubmitButton = true;
    var arrayOfReasonValues = api.state.reasons.map(item => parseInt(item.value));
    var reasonKey = api.state.reason;
    //Validate reason and Add. Info.
    reasonValid = arrayOfReasonValues.includes(parseInt(reasonKey));
    infoValid = !(!api.state.addInformation || 0 === api.state.addInformation.length || api.state.addInformation === null);
    // Validate Date
    var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    var currentMonth = pad(new Date().getMonth() + 1);
    var currentDay = pad(new Date().getDate());
    var currentDate = currentYear + '-' + currentMonth + '-' + currentDay;
    function pad(n) {
        return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n;
    };
    var untilDateValid = Date.parse(api.state.untilDate);
    dateValid = new Date(currentDate).valueOf() < new Date(api.state.untilDate).valueOf();
    // Reason-specific deferral limits: Risk Accepted (2) allows at
    // most 180 days, Fix Unavailable (23) at most 90 - also applied
    // here so switching the reason after picking a date re-validates.
    var reasonCaps = { '2': 180, '23': 90 };
    var reasonCap = reasonCaps['' + reasonKey];
    var withinReasonCap = true;
    if (reasonCap && api.state.untilDate) {
        var maxDate = new Date(new Date().setDate(new Date().getDate() + reasonCap));
        var maxDateStr = maxDate.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(maxDate.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(maxDate.getDate());
        if (new Date(api.state.untilDate).valueOf() > new Date(maxDateStr).valueOf()) {
            withinReasonCap = false;
            helpers.translate("Select a date within {0} days from today.", '' + reasonCap).then(function(value) {
                api.setState("errorMessage", [{
                    "status": "critical",
                    "content": value,
                    "icon": "circle-exclamation-outline"
                }]);
                api.setState("alertMessage", value);
            });
        } else if (api.state.isValidUntilDate) {
            api.setState("errorMessage", []);
        }
    }
    if (dateValid && reasonValid && infoValid && api.state.isValidUntilDate && withinReasonCap) {
        if (reasonKey == 25 && !api.state.hasRequestedRiskReduction && !api.state.hasRequestedDeferral)
            api.setState("submitDisabled", true);
        else if (api.state.hasRequestedRiskReduction && (api.state.desiredRiskRating == 'null' || api.state.desiredRiskRating == api.state.currentRiskRating))
            api.setState("submitDisabled", true);
        else
            api.setState("submitDisabled", false);
    } else {
        api.setState("submitDisabled", true);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-05-16 07:23:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>dc4145a5ff656210d317ffffffffff15</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>validateFormFields</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Exception Management for Unified Security Exposure Management" source="sn_sec_exception">80a1334f8b9a48cba8b4f4c240c1a4de</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Exception Management for Unified Security Exposure Management">80a1334f8b9a48cba8b4f4c240c1a4de</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_dc4145a5ff656210d317ffffffffff15</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-21 05:50:40</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
